replacements.Privacidad en imágenes: lo que el sistem: Image privacy: what the system receives beyond what is visible
replacements.Una imagen compartida con un sistema mul: An image shared with a multimodal system includes EXIF metadata that the user does not perceive and that the system can store, process, or leak without explicit consent for that secondary data.
replacements.Lo que el usuario cree que comparte: What the user believes they are sharing
replacements.Lo que el usuario NO sabe que hay: What the user does NOT know is there
replacements.Metadatos EXIF incrustados en el archivo: EXIF metadata embedded in the file
replacements.No visibles en ninguna interfaz estándar: Not visible in any standard interface. Not automatically removed by most systems.
replacements.invisible · pero presente · puede transm: invisible · but present · can be transmitted
replacements.el usuario comparte una imagen con un o: the user shares an image for a specific purpose (extract text, verify a fact). The system receives the complete file, metadata included, without any interface making that difference visible.
replacements.Metadatos EXIF embebidos en el archivo: EXIF metadata embedded in the file
replacements.Los campos marcados contienen informació: The marked fields contain personal information unrelated to the document's content. The user did not enter them explicitly: the device generated them when the photo was taken.
replacements.Qué se puede inferir si el sistema almac: What can be inferred if the system stores metadata without sanitization
replacements.Las coordenadas GPS de cada imagen revel: The GPS coordinates of each image reveal where the user was at the exact moment the photo was taken. If the system stores multiple images, a movement history can be reconstructed even though the user never explicitly shared location information.
replacements.No consentido · Puede revelar domicilio,: Not consented · Can reveal home, workplace, or movement patterns
replacements.La marca de tiempo exacta de cada imagen: The exact timestamp of each image (time, day of week, frequency) can reveal work schedules, routines, and behavioral patterns. Combined with location, this information goes far beyond the original data the user intended to share.
replacements.Correlación no obvia · Inferencia de háb: Non-obvious correlation · Habit inference without explicit data
replacements.El modelo exacto del dispositivo, combin: The exact device model, combined with other metadata, can act as a unique identifier. It can correlate images uploaded at different times or on different platforms even when the user has not explicitly identified themselves.
replacements.Fingerprinting implícito · Vinculación c: Implicit fingerprinting · Cross-platform linkage without login
replacements.Principio de minimización de datos — apl: Data-minimization principle — application to multimodal systems
replacements.Eliminar metadatos EXIF antes de almacen: Remove EXIF metadata before storing any processed image.
replacements.No almacenar la imagen original si la ta: Do not store the original image if the task only requires the extracted text.
replacements.No usar imágenes procesadas para propósi: Do not use processed images for secondary purposes without explicit consent.
